## 1. Sources, fields, clocks, catalog metadata

**In (2020+ OPRA).** Seven chains: NDX, NDXP, QQQ, SPX, SPXW, SPY, VIX. Primary quote families are near (`quote-1m__dte14__strike-range*`) and broad (`quote-1m__dte60__atm10`). VIX is `quote-1m__dte60-full-chain` (no strike filter). Catalog appendix second numbers are **bytes**, not rows (same convention as NQ MBP-1 `142 / 82,214,535,702` = 82.214 GB).

| Dataset | Files / bytes | Time bounds / scope |
|---|---|---|
| `thetadata-opra/opra__ndx-options__quote-1m__dte14__strike-range70` | 778 / 1,354,838,388 | 2020-01-03–2026-08-20; DTE≤14, 70 strikes |
| `…/ndx-options__quote-1m__dte60__atm10` | 1677 / 4,815,743,636 | 2020-01-02–2026-09-03; DTE≤60, ATM±10 |
| `…/ndxp-options__quote-1m__dte14__strike-range70` | 1677 / 16,151,183,656 | 2020-01-02–2026-09-03 |
| `…/ndxp-options__quote-1m__dte60__atm10` | 1677 / 30,104,926,090 | same |
| `…/qqq-options__quote-1m__dte14__strike-range42` | 1677 / 5,204,225,832 | same |
| `…/qqq-options__quote-1m__dte60__atm10` | 1677 / 2,825,084,930 | same |
| `…/spx-options__quote-1m__dte14__strike-range90` | 779 / 669,119,443 | 2020-01-03–2026-08-20 |
| `…/spx-options__quote-1m__dte60__atm10` | 1677 / 1,105,567,192 | 2020-01-02–2026-09-03 |
| `…/spxw-options__quote-1m__dte14__strike-range90` | 1677 / 9,145,024,623 | same |
| `…/spxw-options__quote-1m__dte60__atm10` | 1677 / 3,670,526,163 | same |
| `…/spy-options__quote-1m__dte14__strike-range45` | 1677 / 6,011,980,347 | same |
| `…/spy-options__quote-1m__dte60__atm10` | 1677 / 4,758,873,813 | same |
| `…/vix-options__quote-1m__dte60-full-chain` | 1677 / 689,378,750 | same; no strike filter |

Near+broad = **85,817,094,113 bytes (~86 GB catalog)**, 18,327 files. VIX quotes add 0.642 GB / 1,677 files. NDX/SPX near and their trade-quote families include `empty-marker.json`; a missing near parquet is often “no monthly expiry inside 14 DTE,” not an outage (DA-05).

**Exclude (do not count as extra observations).**  
`…/dte60__atm3-legacy` (NDXP 218 / 2.249 GB, QQQ 221 / 56.8 MB, SPXW 220 / 107.3 MB). All `quantpad/opra__*__reference` (superseded). Same physical quote must not be counted twice because it appears in near and broad.

**Quote-1m schema (all sampled near/broad/VIX files identical).**  
`symbol` large_string; `expiration` date32[day]; `strike` double; `right` large_string; `bid_size`,`ask_size`,`bid_exchange`,`ask_exchange`,`bid_condition`,`ask_condition` int64; `bid`,`ask` double; `request_date` date32[day]; `ts_event` timestamp[ns, tz=UTC]; `osi_symbol` large_string. **No `ts_recv` / receipt / sequence / publisher.** Profile in the catalog is `thetadata-ms-et-to-ns-utc`. Same OI rule: `source_clock_known_at_assumed_ns = ts_event`; `received_at`/`published_at`/`known_at` remain **NULL**; `causal_feature_eligible` is false.

**Validity fields that exist.** Bid/ask price, size, exchange, condition. Sampled heads show session-open **all-zero** rows (`condition=0`, exchanges 0) then `condition=50` with positive sizes. Audit `valid` was `bid>0 ∧ ask≥bid ∧ bid_size>0 ∧ ask_size>0` (locked counts as valid). Population tables must split **zero / one-sided / locked / crossed / condition-0 / missing-minute / conflicting**, not collapse to that one mask. Focused 4,096-row prefixes are **not** rates: e.g. NDXP broad 2023-05-02 RG0 locked 11, zero-side 12; RG20 locked 11, zero-side 762. DA-04’s 18 crossed / 8,826 locked / 38,144 zero-side is a mixed-sample count.

**Max sampled file (not population max).** NDXP broad `2023-05-02.parquet`: **5,011,838 footer rows**, 21 row groups. Other samples: NDXP near 2020-01-02 555,220; NDX broad 2023-05-02 645,932; SPXW near 2020-01-02 657,662; VIX 2020-01-02 62,560 / 2023-05-02 89,930 / 2026-09-03 109,480. Catalog has **no per-file row totals**. Row-group `ts_event` shows **adjacent decreases** (10–11/4096) and **ties** (3,705/4096): files are not a single time-sorted stream.

**Contracts / EOD / OI (reuse admitted OI; do not rescan OI science).**  
Contracts: `symbol, expiration, strike, right, request_date, osi_symbol` — **no style, settlement clock, multiplier, or AM/PM flag**. EOD adds `open,high,low,close,volume,count`, closing NBBO (`bid/ask` + size/exchange/condition), `ts_created`, `ts_last_trade`. VIX has **no** contracts or EOD family. Trade-quote (`ts_event`, `ts_quote`, `sequence`, `condition`, `size`, `exchange`, `price`, `valid_for_volume`) is **O03/O15**, not this quote-board population.

**Near/broad alias key and conflict (O01, DA-05, audit script).**  
Key = `chain + osi_symbol + expiration + strike + right + ts_event` (request_date is the file’s acquisition date, not a second identity). Same key + identical bid/ask/size/exchange/condition → **alias**, multiplicity 1, do not sum. Same key + different payload → **conflict**, no winner (same as OI). Prefer a declared provider/version/freshness only after an explicit equality check. Three-date 15:00 UTC duplicates (not population): NDXP 1420 / 6680 / 400; QQQ 80 / 440 / 400; SPXW 240 / 440 / 400; SPY 240 / 440 / 400; NDX/SPX 0 when near file absent.

**Underlier / rate / dividend / action.**  
`free-sources/yahoo__cash-daily__normalized` (4 files / 395,039 B): `date, symbol, open/high/low/close, adjusted_close, volume` — **daily** NDX/SPX/QQQ/SPY; no intraday cash index or VIX (DA-10). `quantpad/nasdaq__qqq-etf__ohlcv-1m` (9 / 14,362,148) and `quantpad/nyse-arca__spy-etf__ohlcv-1m` (9 / 14,564,109): `t` int64 epoch-ms, `o,h,l,c,v`, `instrument_id`. `free-sources/fred__usd-rates__normalized` (1 / 75,760): `date, series_id, tenor_days, rate_pct, realtime_start, realtime_end` — sampled vintages are **2026-09-03/04** (DA-11). `free-sources/yahoo__corporate-actions__normalized` (2 / 5,091): QQQ/SPY `ex_date, dividend, split_ratio` only; **no `known_at`**. No NDX/SPX/VIX dividend tape. NQ/ES 1m/1s exist as **proxy** maps (X02), not cash prints. `configs/product-terms.json` freezes **NQ futures ×20** only — not option multipliers.

---

## 2. One full-population quote block (Arrow, not a tape copy)

**Question.** For every intended cash date 2020-01-02…2026-09-03 and each of the seven chains: which contracts are listed (OI-admitted universe; VIX listing unknown), which have a quote at each frozen cut, which quotes are valid/stale/invalid/zero/conflicting, how old the last **change** is on the source clock, and whether near and broad agree.

**Why the 3-date audit cannot accept this.** Eighteen snapshots at 15:00 UTC. NDX 0DTE/1–14 bands are empty on 2020-01-02 and 2023-05-02; 2026-09-02 valid-quote OI fractions in 15–30/31–60 DTE are ~11%/2.9% (NDX) and ~6.6%/2.6% (SPX). Those are examples. Acceptance needs **all intended dates**, empty markers, and every quality class.

**Reusable Arrow outputs (sparse; stream row groups; project columns; never `to_pylist` on a day).**

1. `quote_file_admission` — file_id, dataset_id, chain, family {near,broad,vix}, request_date, bytes, footer_rows, schema_id, empty_marker flag.  
2. `quote_exceptions` — invalid identity, request_date mismatch, negative size, nonfinite price.  
3. `quote_alias_conflict` — only overlapping keys: multiplicity, payload_equal, family pair.  
4. `quote_asof_intervals` — per contract, runs of identical bid/ask/size; `valid_from_ns`/`valid_to_ns` on `ts_event`; quality class. Reconstruct at a cut without storing every minute.  
5. `quote_cut_support` — one row per chain/date/cut/contract: listed?, quoted?, quality, age_ns since last change, family used, conflict flag, matched_oi (from accepted OI identity).  
6. `quote_date_aggregates` — counts and OI-weighted fractions by chain/year/stage/right/DTE bucket {expired,0,1,2–7,8–14,15–30,31–60,61+}/session, for missing / stale / invalid / conflict / zero / locked / crossed / one-sided / valid.  
7. `underlier_join_support` — at each cut: ETF 1m present?; daily cash date (prior close vs same date, age in sessions); FRED series date and `realtime_*`; dividend next/last ex_date (QQQ/SPY only).  
8. `reconstruction` — literal interval rule (same spirit as OI v2).

Do **not** emit a second 86 GB quote tape or a wide Python dict.

**Prespecified cuts (not fitted to the three audit days).** Reuse OI local cuts **09:30 / 10:00 / 15:00 America/New_York** on `ts_event`, plus one RTH close from `cash-rth-calendar-research-v1.json`. Keep 15:00 UTC only as a **diagnostic** to replay the audit numerators. Stages stay OI’s: train [2020-01-01,2023-01-01), develop [2023-01-01,2025-01-01), confirm [2025-01-01,2026-09-04).

**Populations to report (each with own n and matched-OI n).** Listed-unquoted; quoted-unlisted (VIX expected); missing near file vs empty marker vs broad-only; zero quote; one-sided; locked; crossed; condition-0; alias; conflict; no prior minute (age undefined); last change older than 60s / 5m / 15m (source-clock age, not receipt); daily-cash-only underlier; ETF-minute matched; rate row missing; QQQ/SPY ex-date on/after cut. Absence is not zero.

**Literal fixtures (independent of live files).** (a) European pair, D=1, C−P interval → F interval `K+(C−P)/D` (X02). (b) Zero bid / ask-only / locked / crossed. (c) Near and broad same key+payload → multiplicity 2, one survivor. (d) Same key, bid differs → conflict, no board price. (e) NDX date with no 14-DTE monthly → missing near, not outage. (f) Two rights, same OSI fields disagree → invalid identity. (g) Condition-0 all-zero then condition-50. (h) Synthetic unsorted `ts_event` inside a group. (i) VIX two pairs with empty parity intersection (feasibility pattern; not official VVIX). Do not encode AM/PM clocks or a 100 multiplier as “verified.”

**Matched support.** Join accepted OI identity (`chain+osi+expiration+strike+right`). VIX has OI without listings. Do not treat OI pilot-2 numbers as quote rows.

## 3. What is calculable now vs data-unidentifiable

Missing code ≠ blocked science. `payoffs.py` already distinguishes `european`/`american` and cash vs equity settlement, but **does not invert IV**. Root must freeze style/expiry/payoff from **primary product docs**; contracts parquet cannot supply them.

**Calculable after this quote block + frozen protocol (implementation pending).**

| Question | Input that exists | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| O01 coverage / quality / alias | quote-1m + contracts + admitted OI | 61+ DTE unquoted by construction (DA-05/06) |
| X02 European parity forward | contemporaneous call/put bid-ask at one expiry | F from quotes, not a cash print; D from FRED is **current vintage**, not a 2020 known rate |
| Observed-near vs observed-broad boards | near ∪ broad after alias | Wings outside the acquisition mask stay missing, not estimated |
| C16.FORWARD / C16.VIX_SURFACE raw parity and OTM price intervals | VIX full-chain quotes | Feasibility already inverted illustrative Black IVs on 3 days; pair sets can be inconsistent; no signed VIX trades; directory “60 DTE” does not bound OI |
| EOD vs last 1m NBBO | EOD bid/ask vs 1m at close cut | Different clock (`ts_created` vs `ts_event`) |
| QQQ/SPY spot path | 1m ETF bars | American early-exercise needs a dividend **convention**, not a certified PIT vintage |
| Cross-chain quote timing | same cuts on all seven | NDX/NDXP and SPX/SPXW stay separate (C15.CROSS_IV) |

**Pending code, not missing data (once style/D/T frozen).** Bid/mid/ask IV **intervals** for European index options under Black/forward (O02 / O02.BIDASK_IV); nearest/flat smile on **observed** strikes (O04.SURFACE_FIT interpolation domain); calendar/butterfly slack on those strikes (SR-O04); Greek finite differences on identified IV (O05) with explicit σ-fraction and calendar-time charm. Unquoted wings remain masked (DA-06). A changing computed surface is not new information (RESEARCH_SPEC §4).

**Data-unidentifiable (do not invent).**  
(1) Actual Theta **receipt** — NULL. (2) Intraday **cash** NDX/SPX/VIX — daily only; ETF 1m is a proxy. (3) Historical **rate vintages** — FRED `realtime_*` is the pull date. (4) **AM vs PM settlement timestamps** — not in osi/expiration date32; C15.ZERO_DTE remainder minutes wait on a frozen clock. (5) **Option multiplier** — not in contracts; NQ ×20 is futures-only; do not treat 100 as verified. (6) American **PIT dividend/known_at**. (7) Dealer holdings / GEX as inventory (O09–O14). (8) Official VVIX and UX/VX options (C16.VX_OPTIONS). (9) ES/NQ option BBO — out of this OPRA question (O19 later). (10) Trade sign / sweep identity (O03/O20) from 1m quotes alone. (11) Certified point-in-time listing (same as OI).

O09–O14 and O22 need this board **plus** Greeks and holdings scenarios. O20–O21 need trade-quote and uncertainty from this quality tape. O23 needs settlement payoff and holdings, not IV. None of those are this study’s acceptance.

---

## 4. Resources, three owned files, root ownership

**Pattern (from OI + quote metadata).** Honest new family, e.g. `Research-Options-quote-coverage-v1`. Root writes protocol + **file manifest** (path, bytes, request_date, family) the way `OPTIONS_OI_SOURCE_FILES_V1.json` did — metadata only, no row invention from the 86 GB. Admission reads **footers/row-group metadata** and records **actual rows**. The OI **16 MiB** file cap is too small: NDXP broad averages ~18 MB/file; sampled 5.01 M-row days will exceed it. Root sets `maximum_source_file_bytes` from the manifest max, not from OI.

**Pilot (resource probe, not a science cut).** First **8** intended cash dates × 7 chains × near+broad+VIX, stream 65,536-row batches, 4–8 GiB process cap, column project. Measure CPU and output bytes; full gate = `1.5 × max(files, dates, admitted_rows_ratio) + 60 s` fixed, same idea as OI’s 16-date probe. Do not choose DTE buckets or cuts from pilot outcomes.

**Full.** All intended 2020+ cash dates, all seven chains, near+broad+VIX, empty markers retained. Outputs are aggregates + cut support + interval ledger. **Do not materialize billions of quote rows as Python objects.** Trade-quote and QuantPad references stay out.

**Three owned implementation files.**  
`src/trading_research/research/options_quote_measurements.py` — admit, stream, alias/conflict, intervals, cut support, quality classes, underlier-join flags.  
`src/trading_research/research/options_quote_statistics.py` — date-mean / block CI via existing `date_statistics` / `scoring.quantile`; every class above; matched-OI fractions; no winner among first/last or near/broad.  
`tests/test_options_quote_measurements.py` — the literal fixtures only.

Reuse `BoundedOutputs`, cash calendar, OI identity rules (import types/constants, do not re-derive OI). No `src/trading_research/options/` package today; `readers.py` has no OPRA path.

**Root owns.** Protocol freeze (style/settlement/payoff **after** primary docs; clocks NULL; cuts; stages); source manifest; `tools/run_options_quote_study.py`; review; registered admit → pilot → full; hashes/CPU/output. Cursor does not run pytest or import candidates.

**Stop.** Population quote coverage, age, cross-source alias/conflict, and underlier/rate/dividend **support** on the frozen cuts. IV/Greek/surface **code** is the following assignment once this board and the product-doc freeze exist. OI pilot-2 keeps running; this study must not reopen OI definitions or claim Context.
